conviction_note: BFF releases after the close (H1 2026 at 18:20 on 5 Aug), so the reaction falls on 11 Nov. The scale is large: realised vol is 67% and 2026 results-day reactions ran -9.3, -13.7, +8.6 and +5.9. The direction is close to a coin flip. Guidance arithmetic (H1 adjusted EUR81.3m against an FY EUR115-140m guide) leans up; the risk of write-downs after the Bankitalia reclassification and the open Cerberus recapitalisation (exclusivity to end-November, outside the window) cut the other way. So p_up is 54 on an abs_move of 9: a +0.72 scaled number against an impact_sum of -0.1, and the gap is the asymmetry the summed findings cannot express.

FY2026 EUR115-140m. The arithmetic points to confirmation at the upper end, or above it; a raise is possible but not signalled. A cut would need new write-downs.

Capital ratios at 30 Sep: should sit above SREP on the HTC gain plus the EUR110m RWA deconsolidation, unless further reclassifications or calendar-provisioning deductions land. This is the line the market cares about most.
Strategic-process update (Cerberus exclusivity, plan timing). Probably 'talks ongoing', with the sign unknown; the binding decision falls outside the window.
none expected (no 2025 dividend; capital conservation plan)

findings.finding: Guidance arithmetic leaves room to confirm the guide at the upper end or raise it. H1 adjusted net profit is EUR81.3m against an FY guide of EUR115-140m (Q1 43.2, Q2 38.1). Even a Q3 of about EUR33m reaches the bottom of the range by September, so the new line is the FY guide, not the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2 Feb 2026 guide cut (240 to 160) went with -44% (with a CEO exit and provisions). Q1 (guide held at 115-140, ratios above expectations) +8.6% on 12 May; H1 (adjusted +8%, guide held) +5.9% on 6 Aug.
findings.original_quote: Utile netto rettificato pari a 81,3 milioni di euro, in crescita dell'8% (adjusted net profit of EUR81.3m, up 8%)
findings.why_not_priced: At EUR360m market cap the stock trades on about 2.6-3x the guided adjusted profit, so the market is pricing dilution and the capital path, not earnings. A raise would still be a company statement that the run-rate is safe. If the market had priced it, the stock would not have fallen 37% in 60 days with no change to the guide.
findings.independence: Guide reiterated at H1 per Quartr (https://quartr.com/events/bff-bank-s-p-a-bff-q2-2026_F9oZkKk6); Q1 figures in Il Sole 24 Ore (https://en.ilsole24ore.com/art/bff-rimbalza-borsa-analisti-sollevati-numeri-primo-trimestre-AIyxV41C)

findings.finding: The 30 Sep capital ratios should print above SREP. The EUR62m pre-tax HTC gain was booked in Q3, and the EUR127m receivables sale deconsolidates about EUR110m of RWA 'at 30 September'. Against that, H1 showed TCR 12.93% below the 13.36% SREP before the gain (13.6% pro-forma).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026: CET1 about 1pt above Deutsche Bank's expectation, stock +8.6% next day. FY2025 (30 Apr): TCR 12.31% below the 13.3% minimum disclosed, -13.7%.

findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the H1 pro-forma already included the HTC gain. The RWA relief and any includable Q3 retained profit are incremental but small, so the finding is small.

New strategic plan promised for H2 2026, with no date set; it likely follows the strategic-partner decision.

baseline_tension: The priced lean (+2.67, mostly the short-squeeze term) and the flat 20-day run-up are mildly positive. The 60-day -37% shows the market already prices the dilution and capital path. My findings net to -0.1, so they neither confirm the lean nor cut against it; the guidance arithmetic agrees with the lean and the write-down risk opposes it.
language_note: The Italian press (Milano Finanza, Teleborsa) carried the Cerberus terms: EUR180m for 30%, a EUR220m rights tranche, exclusivity to end-November, the bylaw 10% cap, and the EUR2.7bn default reclassification. English sources had only a vaguer EUR300-400m version.
Teleborsa carried the issuer's 2026 board calendar and the 18:20 H1 timestamp that settles the session as amc. English sources gave only the vendor date.
Teleborsa's Equita note carried the company's own figures for the EUR127m sale (-EUR5m P&L, -EUR110m RWA at 30 Sep, more than -EUR30m 2028 calendar provisioning). No English source had them.
Italian press (MF 5 Sep) carried the dissident shareholders' letter (Basilico, Drago, Alken) opposing a discounted sale or capital raise.
lessons_applied: 'In a live bid, results are noise': BFF is in an exclusive recapitalisation negotiation, so the guidance finding goes from +1.5 to +1.0 and p_up from 55 to 54. abs_move_pct is left at 9 because the release and call may carry a strategic update.
'A beat made of a one-off is sold': the HTC-gain finding goes from +0.2 to 0.0.
